# Milestone B acceptance: measured samples

Customer-only HTTPS requests through the official Python SDK. Durations are milliseconds. Each plan has three measured repeats of 100 default writes per region; read-only warmups are excluded from percentiles. Empty `visible` means the request is not a row read. An empty stage means the server did not emit that stage. For forwarded responses with repeated timing names, stage columns use the last endpoint entry; the home timing remains separate. The original first-entry timing parser has been corrected without dropping requests.

Baseline SDK source: `c27dbfa6220ca1a7857b6dc0c95bef220e8684cd`. Full response headers and own synthetic row inventories remain in the local raw-evidence directory documented by the report. No credentials or epoch keys are included.
